subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <ranges> header (C++20+). Phases R1-R29 (2026-05-13) shipped 65 of 78 catalogued symbols. Foundations + concept layer + factories + adaptors + pipe machinery (R1-R10); the full C++23 adaptor batch (R11-R19); output_range / viewable_range / lazy_split_view (R21); internal utilities non_propagating_cache + movable_box (R22, plus iter_move CPO and basic_const_iterator in <iterator>); three one-liner traits range_rvalue_reference_t / range_const_reference_t / constant_range (R23); the 13 ranges:: niebloid CPOs begin/end/cbegin/cend/rbegin/rend/crbegin/crend/size/ssize/empty/data/cdata (R24); prvalue-inner support for join_view (R25); movable_box wrapping in repeat_view (R26) and the 5 callable-storing adaptors (R27); bidirectional upgrades for all 7+ forward-only adaptors (R28); RA optimisation for stride_view/chunk_view/slide_view (R29). The 13 remaining deferred symbols are all blocked on external modules — range_common_reference_t (full common_reference chain); basic_istream_view (<iostream>); common_view (common_iterator from iterator Phase 7c); the seven tuple-dependent C++23 views (elements/enumerate/zip/zip_transform/adjacent/adjacent_transform/cartesian_product); concat_view (<variant>); generator (<coroutine>); ranges::to (concepts + concrete containers).
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <ranges> header (C++20+). Phases R1-R29 (2026-05-13) shipped 65 of 78 catalogued symbols — foundations + concept layer + factories + adaptors + pipe machinery (R1-R10), the full C++23 adaptor batch (R11-R19), output_range / viewable_range / lazy_split_view (R21), internal utilities non_propagating_cache + movable_box plus iter_move CPO and basic_const_iterator (R22), the three one-liner traits unblocked by R22 (R23), the 13 ranges:: niebloid CPOs (R24), and a series of view upgrades — prvalue inner join_view (R25), movable_box wrapping in repeat_view and 5 callable-storing adaptors (R26+R27), bidi upgrades for all 7+ forward-only adaptors (R28), RA optimisation for stride/chunk/slide (R29). The 13 remaining deferred symbols are all blocked on external restd modules — see Roadmap and Pending Dependencies for details.

symbols.name: dangling
symbols.notes: Empty placeholder returned by range algorithms when the source is an rvalue non-borrowed range.

symbols.name: view_base
symbols.notes: Empty marker class. Public derivation opts a type into the default enable_view specialisation.

symbols.name: subrange_kind
symbols.notes: Two-value enum (sized / unsized). C++11+: enum class. C++98/03: struct-wrapper.

symbols.name: unreachable_sentinel_t
symbols.notes: Never-equal sentinel. Templated friend operator== / != return false / true unconditionally. Used as the end sentinel for unbounded ranges. Shipped Phase R9.
symbols.failure_reason: Templated friend operators + variadic SFINAE requirements are C++11+.

symbols.name: enable_view
symbols.notes: Default specialisation returns true iff the type publicly derives from view_base. Variable-template enable_view_v gated on C++14+.

symbols.name: enable_borrowed_range
symbols.notes: Defaults to false for every type. Specialised true for subrange, empty_view, iota_view, ref_view, reverse_view (when base is borrowed), owning_view (when base is borrowed), as_rvalue_view (when base is borrowed), as_const_view (when base is borrowed).

symbols.name: iterator_t
symbols.notes: decltype(restd::begin(declval<R&>())). Routes through the shipped restd::begin overloaded template.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template + decltype dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: sentinel_t
symbols.notes: decltype(restd::end(declval<R&>())).
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template + decltype dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: range_value_t
symbols.notes: iterator_traits<iterator_t<R>>::value_type.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: range_difference_t
symbols.notes: iterator_traits<iterator_t<R>>::difference_type.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: range_reference_t
symbols.notes: iterator_traits<iterator_t<R>>::reference.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: range_size_t
symbols.notes: decltype(restd::size(declval<R&>())).
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template + decltype dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: range_rvalue_reference_t
symbols.notes: iter_rvalue_reference_t<iterator_t<R>>. Shipped Phase R23 as a one-liner over the iter_move CPO machinery shipped in R22.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template dependency precludes a C++98/03 path; also requires the iter_move CPO (R22).

symbols.name: range_const_reference_t
symbols.notes: iter_const_reference_t<iterator_t<R>>. Shipped Phase R23 as a one-liner over the basic_const_iterator machinery shipped in R22.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template dependency precludes a C++98/03 path; also requires basic_const_iterator (R22).

symbols.name: range_common_reference_t
symbols.notes: common_reference_t of the range_reference_t and range_value_t&. Used by zip_transform_view etc.
symbols.failure_reason: Awaits the full restd::common_reference machinery (only basic common_reference shipped in type_traits).

symbols.name: view_interface
symbols.notes: CRTP base supplying empty / operator bool / size / front / back / operator[] / data via lazy template instantiation on the derived type. Public derivation from view_base.
symbols.failure_reason: CRTP + trailing return types + decltype are C++11+.

symbols.name: subrange
symbols.notes: Iterator/sentinel pair. Primary template (unsized) and subrange_kind::sized partial specialisation with cached size. CRTP-derives from view_interface. Specialises enable_borrowed_range to true.
symbols.failure_reason: Requires alias templates, trailing returns, decltype, rvalue refs.

symbols.name: borrowed_iterator_t
symbols.notes: conditional<is_reference<R> || enable_borrowed_range<remove_cvref<R>>, iterator_t<remove_reference<R>>, dangling>.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: borrowed_subrange_t
symbols.notes: Same conditional as borrowed_iterator_t, yielding subrange<iterator_t<R>>.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias-template dependency precludes a C++98/03 path.

symbols.name: range
symbols.notes: SFINAE trait via void_t partial-spec on iterator_t<T> + sentinel_t<T>. On C++20+ this slot will become a proper concept; the trait struct form remains as the back-port.
symbols.failure_reason: SFINAE detection requires void_t + alias templates (C++11+).

symbols.name: borrowed_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND (is_lvalue_reference<T> OR enable_borrowed_range<cv/ref-stripped T>).

symbols.name: sized_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND restd::size(declval<T&>()) is well-formed.

symbols.name: common_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND is_same<iterator_t<T>, sentinel_t<T>>.

symbols.name: view
symbols.notes: range<T> AND is_move_constructible<T> AND is_default_constructible<T> AND enable_view<T>. Approximates the C++20 movable concept with move_constructible alone (conservative); the assignable_from trait is not yet shipped.

symbols.name: input_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND iterator_traits<iterator_t<T>>::iterator_category derives from input_iterator_tag. Iterator-category-based approximation; the C++20 input_iterator concept includes operational checks (dereferenceable, equality_comparable) that this back-port omits.

symbols.name: output_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND a SFINAE-detected indirectly_writable approximation (*it = t is valid). Shipped Phase R21 as a two-parameter SFINAE trait.
symbols.failure_reason: Depends on range trait + void_t-based SFINAE.

symbols.name: forward_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND iterator_category derives from forward_iterator_tag.

symbols.name: bidirectional_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND iterator_category derives from bidirectional_iterator_tag.

symbols.name: random_access_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND iterator_category derives from random_access_iterator_tag.

symbols.name: contiguous_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND iterator_category derives from contiguous_iterator_tag (C++20 tag). Only correctly detects raw pointers and user iterators that explicitly set iterator_category to contiguous_iterator_tag; iterator_concept is not pulled through restd::iterator_traits primary (tracked in iterator roadmap).

symbols.name: viewable_range
symbols.notes: range<T> AND ((view<remove_cvref<T>> AND constructible_from<remove_cvref<T>, T>) OR (NOT view<remove_cvref<T>> AND (is_lvalue_reference<T> OR (movable<remove_reference<T>> AND NOT is_initializer_list<remove_cvref<T>>)))). Shipped Phase R21 as a disjunction-encoded SFINAE trait. Approximations: movable ≈ is_move_constructible; constructible_from ≈ is_constructible.
symbols.failure_reason: Depends on range trait, view trait, initializer_list detection.

symbols.name: constant_range
symbols.notes: input_range<R> AND is_same<range_reference_t<R>, range_const_reference_t<R>>. Shipped Phase R23 as a one-liner once basic_const_iterator (R22) and range_const_reference_t (R23) were in place.

symbols.name: range_adaptor_closure
symbols.notes: Empty CRTP marker base. Closures publicly derive to be recognised by the pipe-detection trait. Shipped Phase R10.

symbols.name: is_range_adaptor_closure
symbols.notes: SFINAE detection trait via conversion-overload idiom on range_adaptor_closure<U>*. Restd-specific name (std uses the concept syntax directly). Shipped Phase R10.

symbols.name: pipe_composition
symbols.notes: Restd-internal closure type that holds two closures and applies them in sequence. Itself derives from range_adaptor_closure so compositions chain. Shipped Phase R10.
symbols.failure_reason: Implementation detail; not in std but exposed for diagnostic / debugging.

symbols.name: operator| (range | closure)
symbols.notes: SFINAE-guarded: fires when RHS is_range_adaptor_closure and LHS is not. Calls closure(range). Shipped Phase R10.

symbols.name: operator| (closure | closure)
symbols.notes: SFINAE-guarded: fires when both sides are closures. Returns pipe_composition. Shipped Phase R10.

symbols.name: non_propagating_cache
symbols.notes: restd::internal::non_propagating_cache<T> — exposition-only in C++20 std. Optional-T storage whose presence does NOT survive copy/move/assignment. Shipped Phase R22; powers the prvalue-inner support in join_view (R25). Wraps restd::optional.
symbols.failure_reason: Requires restd::optional (C++11+) and noexcept-friendly assignment semantics.

symbols.name: movable_box
symbols.notes: restd::internal::movable_box<T> — exposition-only in C++20/23 std. Optional-T wrapper providing default-construction, copy/move, and destroy-and-reconstruct assignment so non-default-constructible / non-assignable T (e.g. lambdas) can satisfy view-concept requirements. Shipped Phase R22; powers repeat_view (R26) and the 5 callable-storing adaptors (R27 — transform_view, filter_view, take_while_view, drop_while_view, chunk_by_view).

symbols.name: empty_view
symbols.notes: Zero-element view of T. All accessors static constexpr. Specialises enable_borrowed_range to true. Colocates views::empty<T>() function form.

symbols.name: single_view
symbols.notes: One-element view holding T by value. Pointer-based begin/end. Not borrowed (owns the element). Colocates views::single(t).

symbols.name: iota_view
symbols.notes: Bounded form iota_view<W, W> (R3) — half-open [start, bound). Unbounded form iota_view<W, unreachable_sentinel_t> (R9) — infinite. Nested random-access iterator with std::ptrdiff_t difference_type (simplification vs C++20 iota-diff-t machinery). Specialises enable_borrowed_range to true. Colocates views::iota(start, bound) and views::iota(start).

symbols.name: repeat_view
symbols.notes: Yields one value N times (bounded form repeat_view<T, ptrdiff_t>) or forever (unbounded form repeat_view<T, unreachable_sentinel_t>). Iterator carries a pointer to the stored T plus a position counter. Random-access iterator. R26 wrapped the stored value in movable_box so the view is default-constructible for any T (non-default-constructible T leaves the box empty until a value ctor populates it).

symbols.name: basic_istream_view
symbols.notes: Reads values of T from an input stream lazily as the view is iterated.

symbols.name: views::empty / single / iota / repeat / istream
symbols.notes: views::empty<T>() — function template. views::single(t) — function. views::iota(s, b) bounded, views::iota(s) unbounded. views::repeat(v, n) bounded, views::repeat(v) unbounded. views::istream not shipped (basic_istream_view deferred).
symbols.failure_reason: Mixed: most shipped, views::istream awaits basic_istream_view.

symbols.name: ref_view
symbols.notes: Wraps a reference to a non-view range; forwards begin/end/size/empty/data. Rvalue ctor deleted. Specialises enable_borrowed_range to true. Shipped Phase R4.
symbols.failure_reason: CRTP + view_interface + trailing return types are C++11+.

symbols.name: owning_view
symbols.notes: Owns a moved-in range; move-only (copy ctor/assign deleted). ref-qualified base() overloads. enable_borrowed_range inherits from underlying. Shipped Phase R4.

symbols.name: all_view / views::all
symbols.notes: views::all is a range_adaptor_closure instance (R10 promotion): inline-constexpr on C++17+, static-constexpr on C++11/14. Three-way dispatch via internal::all_dispatch — view→forward, lvalue→ref_view, rvalue→owning_view. all_t<R> alias resolves to the appropriate result. Shipped Phase R4, pipe-promoted Phase R10.

symbols.name: filter_view / views::filter
symbols.notes: Custom iterator with skip-on-++ (scan forward past failing predicates) and skip-on-- (scan backward, bidirectional only). Begin lazy-cached with mutable storage. Category clamped at bidirectional_iterator_tag (random-access cannot survive filtering). Iterator carries parent back-pointer; not borrowed. R27 wrapped the stored predicate in movable_box for proper view-concept-compliant assignability (lambdas now work). Bound form views::filter(pred) is a filter_closure for pipe composition.
symbols.failure_reason: CRTP + lazy template instantiation are C++11+.

symbols.name: transform_view / views::transform
symbols.notes: Custom iterator with parent back-pointer for function access. Full random-access op set (lazy-instantiated). Reference type = decltype(fn(*it)). Iterator_category carried from underlying (back-port simplification — C++20 clamps based on whether F returns a reference). R27 wrapped the stored function in movable_box. Bound form is a transform_closure.
symbols.failure_reason: CRTP + decltype + trailing returns are C++11+.

symbols.name: take_view / views::take
symbols.notes: Iterator paired with a remaining count; sentinel checks underlying-end OR count-zero. One-word overhead per iterator. Bound form is take_closure.

symbols.name: take_while_view / views::take_while
symbols.notes: C++20-faithful design: no custom iterator (uses iterator_t<V> directly), only a custom sentinel that checks underlying-end short-circuit OR predicate failure. NOT a common_range. R27 wrapped predicate in movable_box. Bound form is take_while_closure.

symbols.name: drop_view / views::drop
symbols.notes: Skip first N elements via lazy first-call advance. mutable cache + init-flag pair. size() = max(0, base_size - n) via SFINAE. Bound form is drop_closure.

symbols.name: drop_while_view / views::drop_while
symbols.notes: Skips prefix while predicate true. mutable lazy cache; end forwards underlying sentinel directly. IS a common_range when V is. R27 wrapped predicate in movable_box. Bound form is drop_while_closure.

symbols.name: join_view / views::join
symbols.notes: Range-of-ranges flattening. Iterator pairs (outer_iter, inner_iter) + parent back-pointer; satisfy() skips empty inners. R25 added prvalue-inner support via mutable non_propagating_cache on the view + tag-dispatched _materialize_inner / _current_inner helpers (reference-inner case is zero-overhead). R28 added bidi support — operator-- backs up through empty inners to find the previous non-empty (requires both outer and inner bidi + V to be a common_range). views::join is a range_adaptor_closure instance (R10).
symbols.failure_reason: CRTP + static_assert + tag dispatch are C++11+.

symbols.name: lazy_split_view / views::lazy_split
symbols.notes: C++20-original input-friendly split. Shipped Phase R21. Each outer iteration yields an inner_view whose iterators share state with the outer iterator via pointer-back. Single-pass-correct on input ranges, distinct from split_view (R16) which is forward-only with subrange chunks. Single-element delimiter only — sub-range pattern deferred.
symbols.failure_reason: CRTP + pointer-coupled inner iterator design are C++11+.

symbols.name: split_view / views::split
symbols.notes: Single-element delimiter form (not pattern). Iterator scans forward to next delimiter, yields subrange, advances past delimiter. Handles trailing-empty / leading-empty / no-delimiter cases. R28 added bidi: m_base_begin tracked, operator-- backs up to find the previous delimiter or to base_begin. Bound form is split_closure. Shipped Phases R16 + R10. C++23 sub-range-pattern form deferred.
symbols.failure_reason: Pattern-range form requires multi-pass forward search inside ++; deferred.

symbols.name: common_view / views::common
symbols.notes: Coerces a non-common range (sentinel != iterator) into a common range via common_iterator.

symbols.name: reverse_view / views::reverse
symbols.notes: Thin wrapper over restd::reverse_iterator. Requires bidirectional + common_range V (non-common needs common_view, deferred). enable_borrowed_range inherits from V. views::reverse is a range_adaptor_closure instance. Shipped Phases R6 + R10.

symbols.name: elements_view / views::elements (incl. keys / values)
symbols.notes: Tuple-protocol projection: views::elements<I> picks the I-th element of every tuple in the range.
symbols.failure_reason: Needs <tuple> integration (tuple_size / tuple_element / get<I>). Restd <tuple> not yet shipped.

symbols.name: as_rvalue_view / views::as_rvalue
symbols.notes: Custom iterator with reference type = iter_rvalue_reference_t<iterator_t<V>>. R22 routed operator* through the restd::iter_move CPO so user customisations are honoured via ADL. Full random-access op set. enable_borrowed_range inherits. views::as_rvalue is a range_adaptor_closure instance.

symbols.name: stride_view / views::stride
symbols.notes: Every Nth element. R28 added bidi support via the missing-field design (m_missing tracks step-overshoot at base_end so -- lands on the actual last yielded stride boundary). R29 added RA support — O(1) operator+= / -= / +(n) / -(n) / [n] using ideal-position (real + missing) calculation. size() = ceil(size(base) / step). Bound form is stride_closure.

symbols.name: chunk_view / views::chunk
symbols.notes: Non-overlapping N-element windows; yields subrange<iterator_t<V>>. Cached chunk_end (O(1) operator*, O(N) operator++). Last chunk may be short. R28 added bidi: operator-- retreats m_n positions on the underlying. R29 added RA: O(1) advance to chunk K via m_start += K*m_n. Bound form is chunk_closure.

symbols.name: chunk_by_view / views::chunk_by
symbols.notes: Adjacent-element grouping by binary predicate. Iterator scans from chunk_start tracking (prev, cur); chunk ends at first false. Cached chunk_end + parent back-pointer. R27 wrapped predicate in movable_box. R28 added bidi: m_base_begin tracked, operator-- scans backward through positions where pred(prev, cur) holds. Bound form is chunk_by_closure.

symbols.name: slide_view / views::slide
symbols.notes: Sliding overlapping N-element windows. Iterator state (start, window_end, base_end, exhausted). R28 added bidi: operator-- slides both endpoints back; from exhausted state, simply clears the flag (positions still cached). R29 added RA: O(1) operator+= shifts both endpoints. size() = max(0, size(base) - N + 1). Bound form is slide_closure.

symbols.name: join_with_view / views::join_with
symbols.notes: Join with single-value separator. Iterator alternates between inner elements and separator via in_sep flag. R28 restructured forward operator++ so the canonical in_sep state has m_outer at the next non-empty inner (allows forward / backward equality) + added operator--. Bidi requires both outer and inner bidi + V common_range. Bound form is join_with_closure.
symbols.failure_reason: CRTP + tag dispatch are C++11+. Range-separator form not yet shipped.

symbols.name: as_const_view / views::as_const
symbols.notes: R22 rewrite: thin wrapper over restd::basic_const_iterator. begin() yields basic_const_iterator<iterator_t<V>>; end() yields the underlying sentinel directly (basic_const_iterator has cross-type ==/!= so common and non-common ranges both work). Dropped ~250 lines of duplicated iterator surface from the R19 original. enable_borrowed_range inherits. views::as_const is a range_adaptor_closure instance.

symbols.name: ranges::begin / end / cbegin / cend / rbegin / rend / crbegin / crend
symbols.notes: Customisation point objects (niebloids) shipped Phase R24. Each uses the priority<N> + poison-pill ADL pattern (same as iter_move from R22). Dispatch order: array specialisation → member function → ADL → computed fallback (begin/end/cbegin/cend/rbegin/rend/crbegin/crend). cbegin/cend/crbegin/crend route through basic_const_iterator. Live in restd::ranges:: sub-namespace to avoid colliding with the existing flat restd::begin / restd::end ordinary-template overloads in <iterator>.

symbols.name: ranges::size / ssize / empty / data / cdata
symbols.notes: Companion CPOs to begin/end family. size dispatches array → member → ADL → end-begin fallback. ssize signed-casts size. empty: member empty() → size == 0 → begin == end. data: array → member data() → &*begin. cdata: const-cast over data. All shipped Phase R24 in restd::ranges::.

symbols.name: enumerate_view / views::enumerate
symbols.notes: Pairs each element with its zero-based index; reference type is a tuple<index, ref>.

symbols.name: zip_view / views::zip
symbols.notes: Cartesian-style zip of N ranges; iteration stops at first to exhaust.

symbols.name: zip_transform_view / views::zip_transform
symbols.notes: zip composed with transform.

symbols.name: adjacent_view / views::adjacent
symbols.notes: Compile-time-N sliding window yielding N-tuples.

symbols.name: adjacent_transform_view / views::adjacent_transform
symbols.notes: adjacent composed with transform.

symbols.name: cartesian_product_view / views::cartesian_product
symbols.notes: N-ary cartesian product; lexicographic iteration over N positions.

symbols.name: concat_view / views::concat
symbols.notes: Concatenates N ranges of a common reference type. Iterator carries a variant of underlying iterator types.

symbols.name: generator
symbols.notes: Coroutine-backed input view. Each co_yield produces one element.

symbols.name: ranges::to
symbols.notes: Materialises a range into a concrete container — ranges::to<vector>(r), etc.
symbols.failure_reason: Awaits restd::<concepts> + concrete container types (restd::vector, ...). Restd does not yet ship any containers.
